propositions: Completion gate verify step enters tool-call loops that exhaust step budget and surface bare LLMError with null diagnostic instead of a verdict
Existing repetition detector metric is inverted and fails to distinguish k-cycles from healthy breadth; windowed distinct-ratio discriminates pathological loops
Provider-broken tool_step_limit empty-filter rewrite causes Bedrock/Anthropic 400 when toolConfig must be defined but history contains toolUse blocks
Runaway detection and recovery must be wired into gate execution to abort loops during run and route to bounded recovery with fresh per-criterion evidence instead of landing error-only
Usage recording (request count, tool-call count, repetition axis) must be durable by default to enable gate tuning and distinguish loop exhaustion from breadth exhaustion
